# SCP-106 "The Old Man"
This guide explains what the object is within the game and how its mechanics work. It does NOT cover the object's lore.
This page collects links to other, more detailed guides about the object and briefly describes each section.
## Round start
At the start of the round or after spawning, SCP-106 is inside its containment chamber. The containment chamber is a security measure that prevents the object from harming facility personnel.
While the object remains inside, it poses almost no threat.
- The facility personnel's objective is to keep the object inside its containment chamber. - SCP-106's objective is to leave the containment chamber.
[textlink="More about containment" link="Scp106Containment"]
## Phantom
The phantom is a key mechanic required for SCP-106 to escape.
[textlink="More about escape methods" link="Scp106ContainmentBreach"]
## Abilities
The Old Man has many unique abilities, one of which is the key mechanic that allows it to escape the containment chamber.
[textlink="More about abilities" link="Scp106Abilities"]
